create_UBatchWrapper: create a UBatchWrapper to wrap a runnable model for micro-batched CUDA graph execution
run_UBatchWrapper_call: run the UBatchWrapper callable to execute model forward passes with ubatching and CUDA graph replay
build_SMControlContextManager: build an SMControlContextManager to control streaming multiprocessor allocation for communication and computation
capture_UBatchWrapper_cudagraphs: capture CUDA graphs for micro-batched runs using the UBatchWrapper's _capture_ubatches method
clear_UBatchWrapper_graphs: clear all captured CUDA graphs from the UBatchWrapper including both ubatch and cudagraph wrapper graphs
